Name: 清算
Description: 卖出所选卡牌，获得等同于所选卡牌费用总和×20的金币。
Description_en: Sell selected card(s) from your hand: gain Gold equal to 20 × the total of the card(s)' cost.

Name: 保险单
Description: 获得1层庇护。本回合每花费10金币，额外获得2层坚毅（最多10层）。
Description_en: Gain 1 stack of Shelter. For every 10 Gold spent this turn, gain 2 stacks of Impregnable (max 10 stacks).
